Box 1161, Camrose, AB

Ken Eg Mechanical, located in Camrose, Alberta, offers a range of automotive repair and maintenance services. Their expertise includes engine diagnostics, brake repair, and air conditioning services, catering to various vehicle types.

The shop is noted for its commitment to quality workmanship and customer service, ensuring that vehicles are operating safely and efficiently. Ken Eg Mechanical serves as a reliable resource for local residents seeking dependable automotive solutions.
